name: Old Shipwreck & Static Dhelmise
summary: Board the barnacle-encrusted hull of the Old Shipwreck dividing Brine Road West from Brine Road East. Explore the tilted wooden decks and flooded lower cabins to find a valuable Nugget stashed between rusted cargo barrels. Take note of the wide deck rupture separating the ship's halves — leaping across to Brine Road East requires the Golbat Boots from Johto. Descend into the waterlogged cargo hold to battle and capture a Level 50 static anchor Pokémon, Dhelmise.

items.name: Nugget
items.method: Found on the lower floor wedged between decayed wooden barrels

Static.notes: Static encounter anchored in the flooded lower cargo hold. Steelworker ability gives 1.5x power to Steel moves.
